transcript.content:
hi, i'm berry.

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you.
the part that stuck with me most was the giant jellyfish floating over the city, pink and see-through, as big as a stadium

a whole jellyfish that big, just hanging there. that's something to hold onto.

what about it stayed with you the most?
the way its tentacles hung down between the buildings, and the whole thing just drifting slowly, like it didn't care about anything

drifting like it had all the time in the world. i can almost see those tentacles weaving down between the buildings.

were you just watching it?
no, there was a girl there with me, on the roof. i didn't know her. short blue hair, yellow raincoat, and an old red bicycle

a stranger, and she's got this old red bicycle with her up there. that's an odd little setup.

do you remember what the two of you were doing on the roof?
she pointed up at the jellyfish, and then she said "get on" and i sat on the back of her bicycle

you just went with it, no questions. that feels like how dreams go, sometimes.

were you yourself in all this, or did it feel different?
i was me, yeah. it all looked like an anime, though, sharp lines and really saturated colours, that orange sunset sky

so it had that bright, unreal look to it, but you still felt like you.

did it feel like something was about to happen, once you got on?
yeah, a bit tense but not scary. she rode straight off the edge of the roof

off the edge, just like that. and you didn't fall.

do you remember what you felt in that moment, right after leaving the roof?
instead of falling we rode through the air, up towards the jellyfish, with the whole city below us, all the lights coming on

that sudden shift, from falling to flying toward it, and the city opening up underneath.

you said it looked like an anime. was there anything else in the dream that felt drawn, or just the whole of it?
the whole thing felt drawn, not just parts of it. the jellyfish especially, it was so pink and glowy against that orange sky

the whole dream had that look. and the jellyfish, that pink glow, it must've been impossible to look away from.

was there anything you were carrying, or anything small that mattered?
i don't remember carrying anything, no

that's fine. often there's nothing, and the big, bright things do enough.

do you remember how it began, before you were on the roof?
no, i don't remember how it started. first thing i remember is being on the roof

it starts right there on the roof with her. that's okay, dreams drop us in like that.

what happened after you were flying toward it?
we rode right up into it, inside the pink light, and then i woke up

so you're on a roof with a girl you don't know, short blue hair, yellow raincoat, old red bicycle. she points at a giant pink see-through jellyfish hanging over the city, its tentacles drifting between buildings, and says 'get on.' you sit on the back, she rides off the edge, and instead of falling you glide up through the air toward it, the whole city lighting up below. everything looks drawn, like an anime, sharp and bright, with that orange sunset sky and the jellyfish glowing pink. it's a bit tense but not scary, and you ride right up into the pink light before waking up.

did i get it right, or is there anything i missed?
you got it right. only thing, you said "drifting between buildings" — that fits pretty well, i don't think you missed anything else

drifting between buildings, i'll keep that. sounds like i've got your dream.

would you like to see it drawn?
yes, i'd love to see it drawn

it could be drawn a few different ways. a bold anime cel: clean and confident, like every edge is certain. or a soft watercolour: gentle and diffuse, with every edge softened. or a linocut print: bold and graphic, like a poster for a forgotten evening. or a sharp anime scene: clean and crisp, every colour vivid and alive.

which of those feels closest to how you saw it, or would you describe your own?
a sharp anime scene, clean and crisp, every colour vivid and alive

i'll start with the giant jellyfish. i picture it huge, as big as a stadium, pink and see-through, glowing, with tentacles hanging down. i'm guessing those tentacles are very large, nothing else about it.

does anything feel different about it, or would you leave it to me?
leave it to you, that fits so far

i'm sketching the giant jellyfish, the girl, the sky above the city, inside the jellyfish, and the old red bicycle now. they'll appear on the right, and that's all for now.

for the rooftop, i'm picturing the edge of a roof on a building in a city, with the city spread out below, and that orange sunset sky. does anything feel different, or should i leave it to you?
that fits, leave it to you

sketching the rooftop now, it'll appear on the right. nothing else is being drawn yet.

and you're in it, so i'll draw you too. would you like to be drawn as you are — you can tell me a little about yourself — or however i imagine you?
however you imagine me is fine
okay, i'll draw you as i see you. sketching you now, and everything's being drawn. it'll appear on the right over the next minute or two. you can say if anything looks wrong once it's there.
the pictures are up now. how do they look?
does it look the way you remember?
yes, it looks right. especially the jellyfish, that pink glow against the orange sky is exactly how it felt

that pink glow against the orange sky, i'm glad it landed for you.

i'll draw the moments of the dream in order now, each carrying on from the ones before it, and they'll appear on the right as they're ready.
sounds good

the first moment's up now, the two of you on the rooftop with the bicycle, her pointing at the jellyfish. three more still to come.

does that look right to you?
yes, that looks right. her yellow raincoat and blue hair look good, and the jellyfish above the city is there too
that's good, the first one's matching what you saw. three more moments are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right soon.
okay, looking forward to them

they're coming. two of the four moments are up on the right now.

does the one with her saying 'get on' and you sitting on the bicycle look right?
yeah, that looks right too. the old red bicycle is there, and i'm on the back
that's the second one matching. the other two are still being drawn, they'll appear on the right soon.
okay

the third one's up now, the moment she rides off the edge.

does it look the way you remember?
yes, it does. it has that feeling of not falling, just going out into the air
that feeling of going out into the air, not falling, that's the heart of it. the last moment is still being drawn, it'll appear on the right soon.
the last one's up now, riding up into the jellyfish. how's that?

riding up into the jellyfish, with the city below.

does it look the way you remember?
yes, it looks right. the pink light inside the jellyfish, and the city lights below, that's exactly it

that's all four moments, then. riding up into the jellyfish, with the pink light and the city below.

thank you for sharing this dream with me. you can look through the whole thing there on the right, in order.
